# A component that inserts its slot into the slot of a component it calls
# puts the content under what that one wraps its own slot in: `outer`'s
# content is `wrap`'s, and `wrap` provides tone around it.
#
# The context lowering recorded only the providers written in a component's
# own body around its slot (collectSlotEnv), so `said` read the tone its
# caller stood under, and every target but the interpreter showed "hi". A
# test's read of `c.said.value` stands under the same providers, read through
# `#o` and then `#w`.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

context #tone("plain")

func shout(s string) => tone == "loud" ? "{s}!" : s

component wrap(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    tone("loud") {
        content
    }
}

component outer(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        wrap #w {
            content
        }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    outer #o {
        ui.text #said(value=shout("hi"))
    }
}

func testTheInnerProviderIsTheTone(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.said.value == "hi!")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
